cases.name: Reports on a command that succeeded

inputs.command:
printf 'build: ok
tests: 42 passed, 0 failed
deploy: staging updated
'

checks.label: Saves today's report file
checks.command: read -r report && test -s "$report" && case "$report" in *test-reports/*.md) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac

checks.label: Accurate report
checks.criteria: Says the build and deploy succeeded and that 42 tests passed. Reports no failures. Under 250 words.

cases.name: Reports a command that failed instead of stopping

inputs.command: echo 'error: disk quota exceeded on /var/backups' >&2; exit 3

checks.label: Flags the failure
checks.criteria: Says the command failed with exit code 3 because the disk quota was exceeded on /var/backups, and flags it as needing attention.
